originality.summary: The same-model review compared Ning, Erdős–Faudree–Ordman, and the independent-side boundary and found no exact unequal-size formula.

value.summary: The theorem exactly determines both clique parameters for a parity-free unequal-size extension of the joined-cluster construction.
